observations.result: 首屏以固定原节点1→2→3→None说明单向链表、值与next引用，head明确指向原节点1；None标为空值，无算法指针抢先出现。
题目目标预览只反转原节点连接并返回原节点3，不换值、不新建节点；随后明确“开始执行·恢复原链”，恢复1→2→3→None作为真实执行输入。
prev初始指空、cur指1；nxt先保存原节点2，1.next仍为2；随后1.next改向左侧None。1954为新反向箭头绘制中间态，2089反向连接落定，nxt仍保留2→3→None入口。
2264 prev从空向1移动，cur仍1；2390 prev已到1而cur才从1向2移动；2484两角色落定，顺序先prev后cur。
第二轮nxt先从2向3移动并落定，此时2.next仍3；2698原2→3箭头收回，2754新2→1箭头接近落定；3018 prev已2、cur随后向3移动，nxt保留3。
第三轮先保存3.next的空值，3293 nxt移动中间态、3373落到右侧None；3495开始画3→2的反向箭头，3615完整3→2→1→None落定；身份、值和节点位置固定。
最后一轮3800 prev从2向3移动，cur仍3；3869 prev已3而cur仍3；3945 cur随后移向None；4040 cur为空，nxt仍空，prev仍指3。
4260先显示while cur及cur为空退出循环，尚未显示返回框；4377才显示return prev→原节点3与head仍指原节点1。
4810仍为总结和正文字幕，4811硬切完整Python代码卡；三张全尺寸代码卡完整12行（含空行），函数接口、while、四行更新、return、平台已定义节点类型前提与暂停提示齐全，无正文字幕和装饰进度条。

limits: This final-MP4 review covers decoded phase samples including intermediate states, not full real-time viewing or a continuous-motion full-video review. Earlier actual no-caption continuous-clip review remains separately recorded in qa-preflight.md/json.
No ASR, full human listening, pronunciation/transcription sign-off, user-comprehension experiment, or user acceptance claimed.
Shared same-SHA full-decode and loudness results were read and cross-checked; this agent did not repeat whole-video decode or loudness measurements.
Code-card stability was measured after decoding/scaling all150 frames to480×270; static does not mean pixel-identical after compression.
Covers were independently reviewed in preflight after the Cover-only fix; this final-MP4 pass did not reopen covers. Published copies and online deployment checks are outside scope.
